adjudication.depicted_input: Lower multimodal-input interface of the Genolator architecture showing the protein-structure embedding/projector output entering token concatenation together with the natural-language question via the tokenizer, immediately before Llama.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible under the atlas rules because it visibly shows an actual model-input interface: the natural-language question and tokenizer path, plus the projected multimodal token stack immediately before Llama. It also includes the protein-structure-side embedded/projected representation entering that shared concatenation mechanism. A full model box or full upstream source object is not required when the serialized representation and immediate interface are visible. This shared architecture figure therefore supports the natural-language question route and the protein-structure virtual-token route.
